items.title: Trump posts 'calm before the storm' image amid reports Iran war could resume after China trip
items.summary: Trump returned from Beijing with no Iran breakthrough and posted a 'calm before the storm' image to social media on May 17, echoing his 2017 phrase that preceded US military action; he also said Iran's 'decimation' is 'to be continued'.

items.title: Iran eyes undersea cables beneath Strait of Hormuz, threatens fees and potential disruption
items.summary: Iranian state-linked media and military spokesperson Ebrahim Zolfaghari threatened to charge tech companies fees for internet traffic traversing undersea cables beneath Hormuz, warning of disruption if unpaid — expanding Iran's coercive toolkit beyond oil.

items.title: Trump returns from China with no Iran breakthrough and faces decision on resumed strikes
items.summary: Trump landed Friday with no Iran deliverable from Xi Jinping meeting; CNN reports he now faces an active decision on whether to authorize resumed US military strikes after the ceasefire deadlock.

items.title: Iran rial at 1,819,000 IRR/USD on May 17 — approaching but below 2M portfolio threshold
items.summary: USD/IRR open-market (havala) rate reached 1,819,000 on May 17, a 3,000-rial increase from May 15; remains roughly 9% below the portfolio D1 threshold of 2,000,000.

items.title: Manifold: nuclear deal by June 30 at 21%; Mojtaba Khamenei survival through 2026 at 66%
items.summary: Manifold prediction markets price US-Iran nuclear deal by June 30 at 21% (aligned with portfolio A1 at 20%); separately, Mojtaba Khamenei's survival through year-end is priced at 66%, reflecting post-succession leadership stability uncertainty.

items.title: Polymarket: Hormuz normalization by end of May at 4%; US invasion of Iran by 2027 at 30%
items.summary: Polymarket prices only 4% probability that Hormuz returns to normal commercial traffic by May 31; the 'US invade Iran before 2027' market is at 30%, up from prior session, reflecting Trump's post-China posture.
